7 Lifetime Investment Verification: 6 Mandatory Conditions Before Booking

Because this represents your lifetime capital commitment, execute these six non-negotiable legal and financial conditions:

1

Demand Bank-Specific Mortgage Release NOC (Vistra ITCL)

Before signing or transferring any token money beyond 10%, insist on a formal, written Partial Release NOC / In-Principle Letter from Vistra ITCL (India) Limited referencing Plot R5-180 (Sr. No. 45) and confirming discharge upon payment into escrow.

2

Deposit Consideration Strictly in Designated RERA Escrow Account

All installment payments must be drawn strictly in favor of the MahaRERA designated 70% escrow account: Axis Bank Ltd., Erandwane Branch, A/C No. ending ...6811. Never transfer funds to secondary sales channel accounts.

3

Verify Execution by All Shedge Family Confirming Parties

Ensure that the registered Agreement for Sale formally includes all adult coparceners of the original land-owning Shedge family as Party of the Third Part (Confirming Parties) to legally extinguish all ancestral title claims.

4

Enforce RERA Milestone-Linked Payment Schedule

Push back on the aggressive 40% upfront demand. Restructure the schedule to: 10% Booking → 15% Agreement → 25% Roads/Drains → 25% Power/Water → 15% Fencing → 10% Possession.

5

Execute Addendum for 5-Year Defect Liability (RERA Section 14(3))

Counter the promoter's deviation by signing an addendum confirming the promoter's statutory 5-year warranty for common layout infrastructure (roads, storm drains, water tanks, retaining walls).

6

Closing Counter-Offer & Fee Waiver Target

Submit a closing counter-offer of ₹ 1.10 Cr to ₹ 1.12 Cr All-Inclusive, or insist that the ₹ 64,000 legal fee be waived and the first year's society maintenance be absorbed by the promoter.
